Data Centers & Texas Environmental Nuisance Laws

Hello,

I believe one of the most important issues regarding the permitting of new
data centers is: How close to residential neighborhoods should they be
built?

I am a resident of Keller, TX whose property is located approximately 500
feet from the proposed 350MW Circle T Data Center in Westlake, TX, and
I am wondering if this project would violate Texas nuisance laws with
respect to noise, air pollution, light and property value.

Can you please provide me with acceptable standards in this regard, and
the plans for enforcement? Will you also please suspend any permit
applications until the applicant can prove that the standards will be met?

I also believe that a minimum setback distance of perhaps 1 mile should
be established.

Thank you for your consideration.

Robert McLeod
521 Llano Ct.
Keller, TX 76248

bobmcleod21@gmail.com
